scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently --names api,web,admin --prefix-colors blue,green,magenta "npm run start:dev -w @reactive-store/api" "npm run dev -w @reactive-store/web" "npm run dev -w @reactive-store/admin"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @reactive-store/web
scripts.dev:admin: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @reactive-store/admin
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run start:dev -w @reactive-store/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
